description: Interactive: two or three of TechFabric's published case studies side by side: each one's challenge, strategy, solution and results, in its own words (the bold statement and the start of each section), with its client, sector and stack where the case study states them, and links to each section. Name them by slug or URL, or give a topic for the closest three; with neither, the list to choose from. Nothing is added that the case studies don't publish. For example: "compare your case studies", "how did these two projects differ", "show me your Databricks projects side by side".
